reuse.why: The change reuses findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, but copies the linking workflow and local unlink field reset.

duplication.why: Fintegra duplicates existing linking and download workflows, six registrations repeat guard orchestration, and replacement duplicates unlinkAccount's local reset.

placement.why: Provider types, configuration, downloads and account operations follow existing layers, although a guard named ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked now also mutates links.

scope.why: All edits directly support the requested linking rules, replacement option and Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Shared guards centralize the rules, but repeated orchestration and copied lifecycle operations leave multiple places to update when linking or unlinking evolves.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The existing bank lookup and import abstractions are used, and unlinkAccount combines local clearing with remote cleanup that replacement must avoid.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes downloadEnableBankingTransactions into a more compact request and return, while retaining its token lookup, POST, error handling and response mapping.

abstraction_drift.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and a replacement branch, turning a validation helper into a mutating operation; all six link registrations still call it.
